item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.20
item.description: Shares anonymous usage counts once a week (days used, how many times each job ran, how many failed and the kind of error). Never your name, licence, Mac, files or anything you work on. Turn it off in Something not right? > Share anonymous usage counts.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.19
item.description: The spoiler name you type is now really written into the burn-in (it was keeping the name already there), and the burn-in shows the right timeline name.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.18
item.description: On a new Mac, export settings Media Composer hasn't got there are swapped for the nearest ones it has (or taken out), and you're told which. The old ones are kept in case it guessed wrong.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.17
item.description: Send logs now sends the zip to Pete itself, attached, with a note of what happened - no email app needed. If it can't, the email opens and Finder comes to the front with the zip ready to drag on.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.16
item.description: Settings (the ⚙ button) now fill the window, with tabs down the side so you see one thing at a time, and scroll bars you can see.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.15
item.description: A little flourish when a split or export finishes (the wallet closes with a stitched tick), stitched progress bars, and a running tally in the ⚙ panel: timelines split, files exported, roughly how much time it's saved.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.14
item.description: Media Composer's 'mixed audio sample rates' warning during an export is now clicked through (Continue) by itself, every time it comes up.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.13
item.description: Send logs is easier: pick Gmail, Outlook, the Mail app or just the zip. Gmail and Outlook open in your browser with the email filled in, so nothing needs setting up on the Mac. Your choice is remembered for the Send logs buttons on error messages.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.12
item.description: Fix: the 'Who is it for?' check showed '(none set)' when the name came from the cut's own burn-in; it now shows the same name as the Spoiler line, and a split never blanks the name in the burn-in. Also: export bin names fit Avid's 64-character limit, and Split works with one press.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.11
item.description: Fix: exports from bins with long names stopped with Media Composer's 'Bin name length must not exceed 64 characters'. The export bins (and the SPLITS bin) now get names Media Composer accepts, shortening the bin's own name if needed. Also in 2.0.10: Split works with one press, and Open a Bin is sturdier.
